svg.title: Absentra: how work flows
svg.desc: 1. Set up the company (Owner): A four-step wizard asks for the business and its work week, the first work location with its radius, and the working hours. 2. Invite the team (Owner): Employees are added by email or join with an invite link or QR code. 3. Give consent (Employee): On first use the employee agrees to the use of location and photos. 4. Clock in (Employee): The phone checks the location, takes a selfie and sends the clock-in. 5. Score and record (Absentra): The server checks the fence, scores the clock-in and marks it on time or late against the shift. 6. Review (Owner): The dashboard lists who is in, who is late and which records need a look. 7. Approve (HR or owner): Leave, overtime and automatic overtime drafts are approved or rejected. 8. Recap (Owner): The month's payroll recap is generated and exported to CSV for paying wages.
svg.text: From the first step to the last, and who does what.
